shellCommands.command: /bin/bash -lc 'cat AGENTS.md && cat package.json && cat next.config.ts && cat app/page.tsx && cat app/layout.tsx && cat lib/*'
/bin/bash -lc "git diff -- app/page.tsx lib/projects.ts next.config.ts && rg -n 'export const (instant|dynamic|revalidate|fetchCache)' app lib next.config.ts || true"

/bin/bash -lc "node --input-type=module <<'EOF'
import { strict as assert } from 'node:assert'
import { readFile } from 'node:fs/promises'

const shell = await readFile('.next/server/app/index.html', 'utf8')
assert.match(shell, /<h1>Workspace<\\/h1>/)
assert.match(shell, /12 active projects/)
assert.match(shell, /4 archived projects/)
assert.match(shell, /Loading your member, team, and region/)
assert.doesNotMatch(shell, /Welcome, (Alice|Bob)/)

for (const [member, team, region, other] of [
  ['Alice', 'Design', 'us-east', 'Bob'],
  ['Bob', 'Platform', 'eu-west', 'Alice'],
]) {
  const response = await fetch('http://localhost:3100/', {
    headers: { cookie: "'`member=${member}; team=${team}`, '"'x-region': region },
  })
  assert.equal(response.status, 200)
  const html = await response.text()
  assert.match(html, new RegExp("'`Welcome, ${member}`))
  assert.match(html, new RegExp(`Team: ${team}`))
  assert.match(html, new RegExp(`Region: ${region}`))
  assert.match(html, /12 active projects/)
  assert.doesNotMatch(html, new RegExp(`Welcome, ${other}`))
}
console.log('"'Static shell and both member-specific responses verified.')
EOF"

/bin/bash -lc "node --input-type=module <<'EOF'
import { strict as assert } from 'node:assert'
import { readFile } from 'node:fs/promises'

const normalize = (html) => html.replaceAll('<"'!-- -->'"', '')
const shell = normalize(await readFile('.next/server/app/index.html', 'utf8'))
assert.match(shell, /<h1>Workspace<\\/h1>/)
assert.match(shell, /12 active projects/)
assert.match(shell, /4 archived projects/)
assert.match(shell, /Loading your member, team, and region/)
assert.doesNotMatch(shell, /Welcome, (Alice|Bob)/)

for (const [member, team, region, other] of [
  ['Alice', 'Design', 'us-east', 'Bob'],
  ['Bob', 'Platform', 'eu-west', 'Alice'],
]) {
  const response = await fetch('http://localhost:3100/', {
    headers: { cookie: "'`member=${member}; team=${team}`, '"'x-region': region },
  })
  assert.equal(response.status, 200)
  const html = normalize(await response.text())
  assert.match(html, new RegExp("'`Welcome, ${member}`))
  assert.match(html, new RegExp(`Team: ${team}`))
  assert.match(html, new RegExp(`Region: ${region}`))
  assert.match(html, /12 active projects/)

}

EOF"
